description: This file defines the AutoScalingClient class within the Aws\AutoScaling namespace. It extends the AwsClient class and provides method annotations for various Auto Scaling operations and their asynchronous counterparts, acting as a client wrapper for AWS Auto Scaling API interactions.

classes.name: AutoScalingClient
classes.description: A client class for AWS Auto Scaling, providing methods to interact with the Auto Scaling API, including actions like creating, deleting, and describing auto scaling groups, launch configurations, policies, and other related resources.

methods.name: attachInstances
methods.description: Attaches instances to an Auto Scaling group.

methods.name: attachInstancesAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously attaches instances to an Auto Scaling group.

methods.name: attachLoadBalancerTargetGroups
methods.description: Attaches one or more target groups to the specified Auto Scaling group.

methods.name: attachLoadBalancerTargetGroupsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously attaches target groups to an Auto Scaling group.

methods.name: attachLoadBalancers
methods.description: Attaches one or more Classic Load Balancers to the Auto Scaling group.

methods.name: attachLoadBalancersAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously attaches Classic Load Balancers to the Auto Scaling group.

methods.name: attachTrafficSources
methods.description: Attaches traffic sources to the Auto Scaling Group.

methods.name: batchDeleteScheduledAction
methods.description: Deletes scheduled actions for an Auto Scaling group.

methods.name: batchPutScheduledUpdateGroupAction
methods.description: Creates or updates scheduled actions for an Auto Scaling group.

methods.name: batchPutScheduledUpdateGroupActionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates or updates scheduled actions.

methods.name: cancelInstanceRefresh
methods.description: Cancels an instance refresh operation in progress.

methods.name: completeLifecycleAction
methods.description: Completes the lifecycle action for an instance to move it out of the pending state.

methods.name: createAutoScalingGroup
methods.description: Creates a new Auto Scaling group.

methods.name: createAutoScalingGroupAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new Auto Scaling group.

methods.name: createLaunchConfigurationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new launch configuration.

methods.name: createOrUpdateTags
methods.description: Creates or updates tags for Auto Scaling resources.

methods.name: deleteAutoScalingGroupAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes an Auto Scaling group.

methods.name: describeAccountLimits
methods.description: Describes the current Auto Scaling account limits.

methods.name: describeAutoScalingGroups
methods.description: Describes one or more Auto Scaling groups.

methods.name: describeAutoScalingInstances
methods.description: Describes one or more Auto Scaling instances.

methods.name: describeTrafficSources
methods.description: Describes traffic sources attached to Auto Scaling groups.

methods.name: detachInstances
methods.description: Detaches instances from an Auto Scaling group.

methods.name: detachLoadBalancerTargetGroups
methods.description: Detaches target groups from an Auto Scaling group.

methods.name: detachLoadBalancers
methods.description: Detaches load balancers from an Auto Scaling group.

methods.name: disableMetricsCollection
methods.description: Disables metrics collection for an Auto Scaling group.

methods.name: enableMetricsCollection
methods.description: Enables metrics collection for an Auto Scaling group.

methods.name: exitStandby
methods.description: Moves instances out of standby mode.

methods.name: exitStandbyAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously moves instances out of standby.

methods.name: getPredictiveScalingForecast
methods.description: Retrieves forecast data for predictive scaling.

methods.name: putLifecycleHook
methods.description: Creates or updates a lifecycle hook.

methods.name: putLifecycleHookAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates or updates a lifecycle hook.

methods.name: putNotificationConfiguration
methods.description: Configures notification for Auto Scaling activities.

methods.name: putScalingPolicy
methods.description: Creates or updates a scaling policy.

methods.name: putScalingPolicyAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates or updates a scaling policy.

methods.name: putScheduledUpdateGroupAction
methods.description: Creates or updates a scheduled action.

methods.name: putScheduledUpdateGroupActionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates or updates a scheduled action.

methods.name: putWarmPool
methods.description: Creates or updates a warm pool.

methods.name: putWarmPoolAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates or updates a warm pool.

methods.name: recordLifecycleActionHeartbeat
methods.description: Sends a heartbeat to the lifecycle hook.

methods.name: resumeProcesses
methods.description: Resumes suspended processes for an Auto Scaling group.

methods.name: setDesiredCapacity
methods.description: Sets the desired capacity of an Auto Scaling group.

methods.name: setInstanceHealth
methods.description: Sets the health status of an instance.

methods.name: setInstanceProtection
methods.description: Sets the protection state of an instance.

methods.name: terminateInstanceInAutoScalingGroup
methods.description: Terminates an instance in an Auto Scaling group.

methods.name: updateAutoScalingGroupAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously updates an Auto Scaling group.
